summary: iteration_38: MAX-mode Sidebar refactor (split into 4 child components under /components/sidebar/) + 4 polish improvements (onDataChanged live stats, $bsonSize for admin, clickable stat buttons, MongoDB compound indexes). All acceptance criteria PASS. Backend pytest 6/6 pass. Frontend UI verified end-to-end for both admin (serkan) and user (ahmet). Zero regression on iteration_36 detachable tabs + iteration_37 live stats.

acceptance_criteria_results.1_admin_sidebar_renders: PASS — [data-testid=sidebar] visible; NEURAL LINK header rendered; [data-testid=neural-link-stats] visible with all 7 nested spans; tab-reorder-group has all 7 tabs (history/tasks/memory/files/email/notes/backup); (SISTEM) amber badge shown next to stat-db-size for admin.
acceptance_criteria_results.2_stats_summary_endpoint_shape_and_bsonS: PASS — Admin: {tasks_active:3,tasks_total:4,notes:0,files:69,conversations:67,memories:0,email_accounts:0,db_bytes:437835,db_mb:0.42,is_admin_scope:true}. User: {tasks_active:0,tasks_total:0,notes:0,files:11,conversations:37,memories:1,email_accounts:0,db_bytes:21045,db_mb:0.02,is_admin_scope:false}. Admin db_mb (0.42) matches expected new $bsonSize value; admin > user; all keys present.
acceptance_criteria_results.3_clickable_stats_switch_tabs: PASS — stat-tasks → tab-tasks active + task-add-toggle visible; stat-files → tab-files active; stat-notes → tab-notes active + note-input visible; stat-memories → tab-memory active; stat-email → tab-email active; stat-conversations → tab-history active + new-chat-button visible. All target tabs receive border-sertex-cyan class.
acceptance_criteria_results.4_detachable_tabs_regression: PASS — hovering tab-notes reveals tab-detach-notes; click creates floating-tab-notes with header 'Notlar', floating-tab-notes-dock and floating-tab-notes-min both rendered; sertex_floating_tabs_v1={"notes":true} persisted in localStorage.
acceptance_criteria_results.5_live_stats_refresh: PASS — Add note via note-input+note-add: stat-notes went 'NOTLAR: 0' → 'NOTLAR: 1' live (no reload). Delete note: 1 → 0. onDataChanged prop properly wired through SidebarTabContent to TasksPanel/MemoryPanel/FilePanel/EmailPanel (grep-verified 3/3/2/2 call sites).
acceptance_criteria_results.6_dock_cycle: PASS — sidebar-dock-cycle rotates through right→bottom→left→top→right; sertex_sidebar_dock_v1 persists (verified bottom, left after 2 clicks).
acceptance_criteria_results.7_sidebar_preset_and_reset_buttons_prese: PASS — sidebar-reset-panels, sidebar-toggle-all-panels, sidebar-preset-save, sidebar-preset-select, sidebar-preset-delete all present (count=1 each).
acceptance_criteria_results.8_user_scope_no_backup_no_sistem: PASS — ahmet login: stat-db-size='0.02 MB' with no (sistem) span; tab-backup count=0 (admin-only, correctly hidden); 6 tabs visible.
acceptance_criteria_results.10_refactor_file_sizes: PASS — Sidebar.jsx=580 lines (down from 965, under 700-line guideline). Child files: NeuralLinkHeader=197, SidebarTabBar=155, SidebarTabContent=156, FloatingTabsHost=48. All testids preserved (data-testid grep shows sidebar-*, tab-*, stat-*, floating-tab-* intact).

critical_code_review_comments: Minor: In SidebarTabBar.jsx DraggableTab.onClick (L45-55) the isFloating branch calls onFocusFloating() then onClick() — good UX improvement over iteration_36 (which only focused the floating window). The 'redock' placeholder [data-testid=sidebar-redock-<key>] is now directly reachable by clicking a floating tab in the bar.
Minor: Sidebar.jsx addNote (L379-386) now calls loadStats() alongside loadNotes() — the stale notes counter issue flagged in iteration_37 is resolved.

Semantic consistency win: backend stats_summary now uses $bsonSize for BOTH admin and user (previous admin used db.command collStats which returned uncompressed size). Numbers are now directly comparable across scopes (0.42 vs 0.02).
MongoDB indexes: startup section (L98-107) correctly adds compound indexes on user_id for tasks/notes/conversations/messages/reminders. Idempotent (wrapped in try/except).
FloatingTabsHost.jsx (48 lines) is a nice thin wrapper — stateless, easy to test. Zero regression on iteration_36 scenarios.

One tiny nit: neural-link-stats renders '(SISTEM)' visually because CSS hud-text uppercases '(sistem)' — the Turkish dotted İ is lost in the CSS transform. Non-blocking (documented since iteration_37).
Consider adding a data-testid to the 'Bu sekme ayrı bir pencerede yüzüyor' branch's wrapper (currently sidebar-tab-floating-<key> is on the outer div — good, already there).

context_for_next_testing_agent: MAX-mode Sidebar refactor complete. Sidebar.jsx (580 lines) is orchestrator; children under /app/frontend/src/components/sidebar/: NeuralLinkHeader.jsx (header+stats+presets), SidebarTabBar.jsx (Reorder+DraggableTab), SidebarTabContent.jsx (tab body dispatcher with onDataChanged passed to TasksPanel/MemoryPanel/FilePanel/EmailPanel), FloatingTabsHost.jsx (maps floating keys to FloatingTabWindow). Backend /api/stats/summary now uses $bsonSize for admin too (was collStats). Admin db_mb=0.42, user db_mb=0.02. All localStorage keys preserved (sertex_tab_order_v1, sertex_sidebar_dims_v1, sertex_sidebar_dock_v1, sertex_floating_tabs_v1, sertex_floating_tabs_geom_v1). Stats onClick handler is handleStatClick in Sidebar.jsx (L402-407): sets active tab + focuses floating window if that tab is currently detached. Note: `[data-testid^=tab-]` selector matches 4 testids per tab (tab-wrap-, tab-, tab-grip-, tab-detach-) → total = tab_count × 4; use exact testids like [data-testid=tab-history] to count individual tabs.
